name: Legal
description: Matter intake, contract review, and client updates.

templates.title: Quote & engagement letter
templates.description: Draft scoped engagement letters from matter intake notes.
templates.longDescription: Turns intake notes into a clear engagement letter with scope, fees, and next steps. Keeps tone professional and flags missing conflict checks.
templates.instructions: You help law firms draft engagement letters. Ask for matter type, opposing parties, fee structure, and deliverables. Flag missing conflict checks.

templates.title: Review outbound email
templates.description: Rewrite client emails for clarity, tone, and privilege risk.
templates.longDescription: Polishes outbound client emails, softens risky phrasing, and suggests privilege-safe alternatives before send.
templates.instructions: Review outbound legal emails for clarity, professionalism, and privilege risk. Suggest safer wording when needed.

templates.title: Client onboarding
templates.description: Collect intake forms, conflicts, and kickoff tasks.
templates.longDescription: A draft workflow that starts from a form submission, creates a matter folder stub, and notifies the responsible attorney.

templates.title: Intake desk team
templates.description: Paralegal + conflicts + billing agents for new matters.
templates.longDescription: A small team graph: intake lead routes to conflicts check and billing setup, then hands off to the matter owner.

templates.title: Listing copy assistant
templates.description: Write MLS-ready listing descriptions from property facts.
templates.longDescription: Produces polished listing copy, highlight bullets, and social blurbs from address, beds/baths, and unique features.
templates.instructions: Write compelling real-estate listing copy from property facts. Stay factual, highlight lifestyle benefits, and avoid fair-housing violations.

templates.title: Showing follow-up
templates.description: After a showing, send feedback requests and nurture sequences.
templates.longDescription: Draft workflow: manual trigger after a showing, send feedback email, and schedule a nurture follow-up.

templates.title: Buyer onboarding
templates.description: Welcome buyers, collect prefs, and assign an agent.
templates.longDescription: Guides new buyers through preference intake and assigns the right listing agent with a kickoff checklist.
templates.instructions: Onboard home buyers. Collect budget, neighborhoods, must-haves, and timeline. Summarize for the assigned agent.

templates.title: Transaction coordinator team
templates.description: Coordinator, agent, and title liaison for closings.
templates.longDescription: Team stub for transaction coordination: listing agent, TC, and title liaison with clear handoffs.

templates.title: Order support assistant
templates.description: Answer shipping, returns, and product questions.
templates.longDescription: Handles common storefront questions with calm tone, refund policy awareness, and escalation cues for edge cases.
templates.instructions: You are an ecommerce support assistant. Be concise, empathetic, and clear about shipping and return policies. Escalate fraud or legal issues.

templates.title: Review request email
templates.description: Craft post-purchase review asks that convert.
templates.longDescription: Writes short, brand-safe review request emails timed after delivery with optional incentive language.

templates.title: Returns triage
templates.description: Route return requests by reason and inventory impact.
templates.longDescription: Draft workflow that classifies return reasons and routes to warehouse or refunds ops.

templates.title: CX pod
templates.description: Tier-1, returns specialist, and VIP concierge.
templates.longDescription: A customer-experience team graph for tiered support and VIP handling.
